visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Pairs with Missing Values
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Zipping [1,2,3] with ["x"] should give [[1,"x"]], but the program also prints pairs containing null.

solution.explanation: Looping up to the longer length reads positions that do not exist in the shorter array, giving undefined (shown as null). The number of pairs is limited by the shorter array.
